summary: Full backend + frontend verification of 4 new features: extra fees, discount management, signed contract upload (Emergent Object Storage), and mother/guardian form sections. 10/10 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend UI verifies fee-summary live compute (₺21.500 for total=20000, kaynak=500, dijital=1000; ₺19.500 after ₺2.000 kardeş discount), all 4 collapsible sections present with Ekstra Ücretler open by default, drawer for student-001 shows drawer-net-total=₺23.500 with Kaynak/Dijital rows and eylul-yilmaz-sozlesme.pdf + Görüntüle button, and Documents contract preview auto-fills Ayşe Yılmaz (mother), Kaynak/Dijital rows, İndirim Yapıldı ( X ) Evet, ( X ) Kardeş İndirimi. All previous features (dashboard, students list, documents, users, audit, reports) confirmed intact via nav sidebar.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/students/{id} accepts arbitrary dict without pydantic validation on the patch body (filters via Student.model_fields set-inclusion, which is safe but silently drops unknown keys). Fine for MVP.
Contract upload endpoint reads raw request.body() — enforces 10MB after full body read. For very large bodies, prefer Content-Length pre-check or streaming to reject early. Non-blocking for now.
server.py is ~894 lines — consider splitting into routers/ modules (auth, students, contracts, reports) if further growth expected.
Frontend App.js is a single large file; DISCOUNT_TYPES/EXTRA_KEYS well-modeled but Modal component (~200 lines) could be extracted for maintainability.

Final DB cleanup removed all TEST_ residuals. student-001 (Eylül Yılmaz) pre-existing data intact: mother_name='Ayşe Yılmaz', discount_type='kardes', discount_amount=2000, extra_fees={kaynak:500,dijital:1000}, signed_contract_filename='eylul-yilmaz-sozlesme.pdf'.
